items.text: This update primarily focuses on asset reorganization and bug fixes. Please note that due to optimizations made to the game's overall file structure, the download size for this update is larger than usual. We appreciate your understanding and patience.
※【PC】 If you encounter infinite loading or a black screen after updating the game, please try the following steps:
Update to the latest version and verify the integrity of your game files:
Right-click the game in your Steam Library → Select “Properties” → Go to “Installed Files” → Click “Verify integrity of game files."
Go to Steam Settings → “Downloads” → Disable “Shader Pre-Caching."
Right-click the game → “Properties” → Disable Cloud Saves, then restart Steam.

If none of the above resolves the issue, try reinstalling the game.: ※If your monitor does not support a refresh rate of 120Hz or higher, we recommend setting it to 60Hz for a smoother framerate experience.: The following updates apply to Steam Version 1.2.004 and PS5 Version 1.000.033: 1. System: -Optimized the game's file organization structure to better accommodate future updates. This change also reduces runtime memory usage and minimizes the occurrence of game crashes.: -Fixed several issues related to scene and level loading.: -Fixed an issue where audio was missing when using the Steam Game Recording feature.: 2. Combat: -Fixed various issues related to the Trials of War.: -Fixed several issues regarding player weapon skills and enemy attack patterns.: 3. Visuals & Art: -Fixed several visual bugs.: -Optimized the visual presentation and details of certain armor sets.: 4. Miscellaneous: -Fixed various text errors and localization issues in certain languages.: -Fixed several sound effect issues.

We would like to thank all players for your valuable feedback and suggestions regarding the AI LIMIT DLC Eirene’s Furnace of War. We are actively monitoring community feedback and will continue to make adjustments as quickly as possible.
We sincerely apologize to anyone who experienced issues while playing the DLC and for any disruption to your experience.
Our team is working hard to address these issues. Some fixes are included in this update, while others—either still in progress or requiring further testing—will be implemented in future updates.
Additional Note

If you are unable to trigger the dialogue with Assis at the Temporary Campsite after completing the game, it may be because the DLC has not been properly added to your account. Please try adding the DLC from the store page and restarting the game.
Changes in Version 1.2.003
1. Systems
-Added Furnace Records to the central Warfare Sandbox in Temple of War – Hall of Crucible, allowing players to view statistics for Trials of War, Boss Rechallenges, and Furnace Judgment.
-Fixed an issue in Trials of War where selecting the ability seal “Virtuoso of Weapons” could frequently cause game errors during continued play.
-Fixed an issue where a boss phase transition cutscene could trigger during player respawn in Trials of War, causing errors in the respawn process.
-Fixed an issue where the mouse scroll wheel would not function properly in certain UI screens.

notes.title: -Updated the default input for reading collectible items to

items.text: Shift + H (Keyboard) / LT + Select (Xbox) / L2 + Touchpad (DualSense)
to prevent conflicts with the Notebook/Map shortcut.
2. Combat
-Fixed an issue where using the weapon Wilted Foliage skill “Star Fall” near NPCs could cause game errors.
-Fixed an issue where reward calculation could fail if the player and the boss “Guardians of the Tree” were defeated simultaneously.
-Reduced cases in Trials of War where the Commander could die outside the playable area due to edge cases, making dropped items unreachable.
-Further reduced instances where enemy hit reactions could shift model positioning, causing animation issues.
3. Visuals
-Fixed vegetation rendering issues in The Sphere – Celestial Tree Garden.
-Reduced cases in Trials of War where players could enter out-of-bounds areas or become stuck in terrain.
-Removed duplicate pages from the digital artbook.
4. Miscellaneous
-Fixed various localization issues.
-Fixed several audio issues.

releases.displayName: AI LIMIT Now Supports Steam Cloud Saves!

items.text: We have officially launched the Steam Cloud Save feature. To avoid potential issues with your save files, please take note of the following:
Manually back up your save files regularly.
C:\Users\(Your Username)\AppData\LocalLow\SenseGames\AILIMIT
If you can’t find the folder, go to the top menu in File Explorer, select View, and enable Show Hidden Files.
Do not force close Steam or use Task Manager to terminate it while Steam Cloud is syncing. Avoid force-quitting the game or shutting down your PC abruptly.
The first upload to the cloud may take some time depending on your network speed. Please be patient.

If your internet connection is unstable or Steam doesn’t have enough time to sync your save, discrepancies may occur between your local and cloud save. If prompted with a sync conflict, carefully review the differences and choose wisely to prevent data loss.
If you prefer not to use this feature, you can disable it by right-clicking the game in your Steam library, selecting Properties, and turning off Cloud Saves in the settings.
🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/bTBPQPVz7D
We sincerely apologize for the bugs encountered at launch.
If you experience any of the following issues, please exit Steam and update the 6.5GB patch:
·Main menu text not displaying
·Stuck in the Lore Boss fight
·Deluxe Edition reward chest not appearing
If you continue to experience black screen issues, achievements not unlocking, infinite loading, or missing Russian text after updating, please try the following:
·Right-click the game in your Steam library → Select "Properties" → Go to "Installed Files" → Click "Verify integrity of game files"
·Open Steam settings → Go to the "Downloads" section → Disable "Enable Shader Pre-Caching" to improve performance
If the issue persists, please uninstall and reinstall the game.
Additionally, if the "Language Selection" screen at the start does not display Russian, please select another language to enter the game, then switch to Russian in the "Game Settings" menu.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

releases.displayName: AI LIMIT Demo Version Update Log #1

items.text: We sincerely thank all players for their valuable feedback and suggestions. The Demo version will continue to incorporate feedback from the player community, and adjustments will be made as quickly as possible.
Below are the changes and fixes applied in Steam Build lD:16068753 / Version 1.0.009
1.System
1.1 Fixed an issue where the mouse could not be used to allocate points in the "Upgrade" page.
1.2 Optimized the information panel for the Primary Seal.
1.3 Improved the camera movement speed when using the mouse.
1.4 Temporarily turn off VSYNC and Motion Blur by default.
2.Combat Balance – Main Character
2.1 Increased the damage of all weapons within the Dual weapons module.
2.2 Reduced the startup time for weapon skill of the Blader Greatsword.
2.3 Enhanced the Overload Burst damage and sync rate recovery of the Frame ability "Shield".
2.4 Improved the Poise for the final attack in standard combos for the following weapons: Blader Greatsword, Serrated Halberd, Knight's Lance, and Impact Drill.
3.Combat Balance – Enemies in Stages
3.1 Reduced HP for certain enemies.
3.2 Lowered the poise and attack angle correction for all robot types.
3.3 Decreased the HP and damage of the Lost Blader and Necro Floater.
4.Combat Balance – Boss: Lore, the Lost Lancer
4.1 Decreased the Boss's HP and damage
4.2 Shortened the hitbox duration for several attacks and reduced angle corrections.
4.3 Fixed AI behavior logic issues.
4.4 Lowered the remaining HP of the Boss after phase transitions.
5.Combat Balance – Challenge Boss: Hunter of Bladers
5.1 Reduced the Boss's HP, sync rate damage, and the sync rate tier bonus to attack power.
5.2 Decreased the sync rate recovery ability triggered by headaches.
5.3 Lowered the frequency of backward flashes.
5.4 Reduced the damage and angle correction for certain attacks.
5.5 Shortened the hitbox duration for skills with explosion.
6.Other Details and Fixes
6.1 Fixed a UI text error.
6.2 Resolved missing subtitles in the Traditional Chinese and Japanese versions.
6.3 Adjusted the facial features of the main character and fixed issues with cartoon render outlines.
6.4 Optimized the item placement sequence in the tutorial area.
6.5 Fixed a bug where reverse map running triggered hidden respawn points.
6.6 Resolved scene component disappearance issues caused by occlusion culling.
6.7 Improved performance in certain areas.
6.8 Fixed a black screen issue during cutscenes on the PS5 version.

Additionally, based on the feedback received from the Demo, significant adjustments will be made to the balance and values in the official version.Once again, thank you all for your valuable feedback!
